answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the island of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
